_how_to_use: List prices for the 'list price' column of COSTS.md. The pipeline was run on free tiers, so nothing was paid: this column says what the same calls would cost at list price. Fill in usd only from the provider's own pricing page, with the date you checked. A model with no entry, or usd null, shows as n/a.
_units: per_image | per_megapixel | per_1k_chars | per_1m_tokens (usd_in, usd_out) | per_gpu_minute

gemini-3.8-flash-tts.note: If the page prices speech per token, convert once and write the conversion here.

kaggle_gpu.source: price of a comparable rented T4, for example a public cloud's on-demand page
